moodys.citation_text: Moody's 2020 action: 'assigns A1 to Geisinger Health System's (PA) Ser. 2020A,B,C&D and downgrades existing bonds; outlook to stable' — A1/Stable in effect at start of window. (Note: trade press references the prior downgrades from Aa2 -> Aa3 -> A1 occurring before 2023.)

sp.citation_text: S&P typically rates Geisinger one notch above Moody's equivalent; A+ stable consistent with mid-A category through window.

fitch.citation_text: No Fitch rating action on Geisinger identified in trade press.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Downgraded outstanding bonds from A1 to A2; outlook stable
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Expectations of continued cash flow weakness; weak operating cash flow expected to persist.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: 'Moody's Investors Service downgraded Danville, Pa.-based Geisinger Health System's outstanding bonds from A1 to A2 on February 13 amid expectations of continued cash flow weakness... Geisinger's outlook is stable, and it has about $1.3 billion of debt outstanding.'

moodys.citation_text: A2/Stable in effect from Feb 13, 2023 downgrade onward.

sp.citation_text: No S&P action identified during window.

outcome_class_rationale: Moody's downgraded Geisinger one notch (A1 to A2) on February 13, 2023 within the verification window. Note: Risant Health closed its acquisition of Geisinger on March 31, 2024, but no concurrent rating action identified.
